decisions.reason: The protection cap is a low-cost accessory that builds directly on the firm's coupling know-how and supports after-sales, though its absence from the website after 2019 suggests it may be quietly folded into the general accessory range.
Box trailers sit at the heart of the firm's production knowledge, so it can read market feedback and keep improving the series, even if its models may be refreshed or renamed.

The car transporter line extends the firm's chassis and axle expertise into a professional niche it can still refine through its dealer network, although demand is more specialised and the lack of later visibility adds some uncertainty.
The low-bed series draws closely on existing trailer design and production skills and was a featured line, so the firm is well placed to keep developing it.
This second box trailer series lies within core competence, but its overlap with Product B raises the chance of consolidation, similar to the earlier withdrawal of the cover series.
